track_name: World Wide Technology Raceway (Gateway) - Road Course
title: iRacing GR86 World Wide Technology Raceway Guide 1:04.6 Toyota GR86 Gateway Track Guide

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake at second and third seams, 50%, trail brake to third gear

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brake briefly to 10% before entrance road
corners.line: Cut corner, left tires on curb, right tires on track

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: 50-55% before curbing, 25-30% at black tires, 14-15% near right curb
corners.line: Shallow angle, left tires in grass, right tires on track
corners.exit: Blip of gas, back on brakes, pick up in third
corners.mistakes: Giving too much room on right side

corners.braking: 40% at tire wall, trail off to cones

corners.line: keep belted down, run load line
corners.exit: car comes up by itself, over across the line

general_tips: Use engine braking to drop to third gear
keep right pedal to the floor
